'''Wolentic Dudge''' was a [[Frejuke]] resident of [[Kijimi City]] on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]]. He was a good fit for the world's [[Temperature|cold]] climate due to his [[species]]' heat-retaining blubber, although he also wore a [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|vest]] lined with [[kybuck]] [[Hair|fur]] for added warmth,<ref name="CGttSWG" /> as well as brown pants, brown shoes, and a black [[belt]] with a [[comlink]] built into the buckle.<ref name="TROS VD" /> A proud member of the [[city]], Dudge was forced to endure its [[Occupation of Kijimi|occupation]] under the [[First Order]]<ref name="CGttSWG" /> in [[35 ABY]], which ended with the [[Destruction of Kijimi|destruction]] of Kijimi by the [[Sith Eternal]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Dudge had light skin and dark [[eye]]s that were sensitive to glare.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wolentic Dudge was created for the film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="Art of">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> which was released on [[December 20]], [[2019]].<ref name="Jedi Redeemed">{{InsiderCite|196|The Jedi Redeemed: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker|The Jedi Redeemed: ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker''}}</ref> A concept sculpture of the character, titled "Wizard 60," was created by artist [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Art of">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> Dudge's name was first revealed in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/book/9780241357699-star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars The Rise of Skywalker The Visual Dictionary}}</ref> The character was portrayed by veteran ''[[Star Wars]]'' actor [[Warwick Davis]], continuing the tradition of Davis's characters having names beginning with a "W". Davis also portrayed [[Wizzich Mozzer]] in the film.<ref name="FascinatingFacts">''[[Star Wars: Fascinating Facts]]''</ref>
